rows.en: (Today Luca and I came to Folmo.)

\p-san,
sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Also Shirakawa to the female player (frd_myk_105).

rows.en: I only just got here myself.
That's good, then.
Shall we look around a bit?

If I remember right, there's a shop here
with really good soft serve.

I hear they use fresh milk from
the hippo-cows raised at Folmo.
I wonder where that shop is?
If you want to try some, let's go find it.
(Today Luca-kun and I came to Folmo.)
I only just got here myself.
Let's look around a bit!
(Luca and I came to Folmo again today.)
\p-san, over here!
Sorry, sorry, I'm late.

No, please don't worry about it.
I just got here myself.
Well then, shall we look around a bit?
That soft serve was delicious, wasn't it?

Though two guys eating soft serve
together is kind of...
P-please don't bring that up...

Well, now that we've refueled,
let's hang out a little longer.
(Luca-kun and I came to Folmo again today.)
Yeah~ I could eat any number of them.

If you eat too much,
you'll upset your stomach, you know?

Hey... you shouldn't say things like that
to a girl!
(What should I do after school today?)
rows.notes: x12, also in frd_rnk_101 / frd_rnk_113, both genders.

rows.en:
\p-san,
is something the matter?

Nah, I was just wondering
what to do after this.
Then how about we go have some tea?
Sounds good. Let's invite everyone.
...In the end, it was just the two of us...
Everyone said they were busy.

Who cares? Let's enjoy our drinks,
just the two of us!
I was just wondering what to do after this...
Ooh, nice. Let's invite everyone.
Everyone said they were busy~

Oh, who cares? Let's enjoy our drinks,
just the two of us!
\p-san, is something the matter?
I was wondering what to do after this.

Sounds good. This time,
let's really invite everyone.
...Just the two of us again...
I wonder if everyone's busy?
Sigh... I guess this part can't be helped.

Let's shake it off.
After our tea, let's go have fun somewhere.
I was thinking about what to do after school.

Ooh, nice. This time,
let's really invite everyone.

Let's shake it off.
After our tea, let's go have fun somewhere!
(Today I'm going to Central Park with Luca.)

You're early,
\p-san.
rows.notes: x8. The script also repeats this line mid-scene and right before the closing monologue (after 'Yes!'); translated for its first use, the meeting, which the reply 'you're here before meeting time too' settles.

rows.en:
Says you, Luca.
You're here before meeting time too.
Oh, you're right.
Well, let's just take a nice, slow walk today.
This is kind of soothing, isn't it?

All the green is easy on the eyes,
and it's cool in the shade of the trees.

Today I got to forget the daily hustle
and bustle and just relax.

Aren't you way too worn out
for a student, Luca...?
Th-that's not true.

(Today I'm going to Central Park
with Luca-kun.)

Says you, Luca-kun.
You're here before meeting time too.
Let's take a nice, slow walk today.

All the green is easy on the eyes,
and it's so cool in the shade of the trees.

Aren't you way too worn out
for a student, Luca-kun...?

(I'm hanging out at Central Park
with Luca again today.)

You're early again today,
\p-san.
I meant to get here before you, Luca...
What are you trying to compete with me for...?
Well then, let's go cycling today.
Whew, I'm pretty tired.

Before I knew it,
it had turned into a road race...

That's because you kept
trying to beat me, \p-san...
But it was fun, wasn't it?
Shall we come again?

(I'm hanging out at Central Park
with Luca-kun again today.)
I meant to get here before you, Luca-kun...
Ehehe! Let's go cycling today.
Let's come again!

uncertain: c09388: 'You're early, \p-san.' (x8) is also repeated by the script mid-scene and before the closing monologue; translated for the meeting use.
